tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: The ground every window sits on. Always under the ground glow (glow-warm, glow-cool); never a card colour.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Primary text and the stacked pills of the mark, on background and on glass. 15:1+ in both themes.

tokens.name: glow-warm
tokens.usage: Top-right radial haze of the ground. Atmosphere only: never behind text without glass between.

tokens.name: glow-cool
tokens.usage: Bottom-left radial haze of the ground; balances glow-warm.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Glass panels, rows, chips. Always with backdrop blur (blur-md) and a hairline border. Never nest glass in glass.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on card.

tokens.name: glass-strong
tokens.usage: Hovered or selected glass: rows, chips, glass buttons.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px edge on every glass surface and divider lines inside panels.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Opaque surfaces that float above everything: dialogs, menus, tooltips' fallback, reduced-transparency mode.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on popover.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The inverse pill: the one main action per view, the active segment, tooltips. Ivory on smoked, ink on frost.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Glass buttons and quiet controls.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on secondary.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Tracks, input wells, icon circles inside rows.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, captions, inactive icons. 6:1+ on background and on card.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: shadcn's hover wash for ghost buttons and menu items. Not the brand accent: that is ember.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on accent.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: THE warm signal: active nav, the primary chart line, progress fills, the switch's on state, focus. At most ~10% of any screen. As a fill, put ember-foreground on it.

tokens.name: ember-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ember fill (7:1 dark, 5.4:1 light).

tokens.name: ember-text
tokens.usage: Ember as TEXT on background or card (links, highlighted numbers). Light uses a deeper ember to pass 4.5:1.

tokens.name: ember-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind ember-text: ember badges, the active dial segment.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Healthy / running, always with the word. Text-safe on background, card and success-soft.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of success badges.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Starting, degraded, needs attention. Always with the word.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of warning badges.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational findings, staging env badge.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of info badges.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Prod, stop, remove, errors. As text on card/popover, or as a fill with destructive-foreground.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on a destructive fill.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of danger and PROD badges.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: shadcn default border: opaque surfaces (popover, dialog, menu).

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Input and outline-button borders, switch track border.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px, offset 2px. 3:1+ against every surface.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Primary series (the thing the chart is about).

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Comparison series, thin (1.5px).

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third series; also the lime cover block.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Fourth series.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Fifth series. More than five series: use a table.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: The floating nav rail (glass, darker than card in dark).

tokens.name: sidebar-foreground
tokens.usage: Rail icons at rest.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary
tokens.usage: The active rail item's circle: ember on smoked, ink on frost.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Icon on the active rail circle.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: Rail item hover.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Rail icon on hover.

tokens.name: sidebar-border
tokens.usage: Rail edge.

tokens.name: sidebar-ring
tokens.usage: Rail focus ring.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per window: the page title in the header row.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Badges, segmented controls, small buttons. Sentence case.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: A measured number that IS the answer (disk used, uptime). Never a decorative hero metric.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Row meta, table numbers, kbd hints.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label nudge inside badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside buttons; between rail items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between rows in a list; row inner gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked elements inside a panel.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between bento panels.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Window content padding; header to content.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Large separations: empty states, welcome screen.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: kbd hints, tiny chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Menu items, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, dial chips; shadcn --radius.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: List rows, menus.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Panels (cards), dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: The nav rail and the window's content shell.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, badges, segmented controls, search, icon circles.

tokens.name: shadow-edge
tokens.usage: The lit top edge of glass. Every glass surface.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Things that float over content: rail, dialogs, menus, the dial knob.

tokens.name: shadow-ring-ember
tokens.usage: Halo on the active rail item and focused inputs.

blur.note: backdrop-filter radii. Real macOS vibrancy comes from the window (see shadcn.md); these blur what is inside the window.

tokens.name: blur-sm
tokens.usage: Glass buttons and chips.

tokens.name: blur-md
tokens.usage: Panels, rows, search.

tokens.name: blur-lg
tokens.usage: Rail and sheets (terminal drawer).
